Hi Sasha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV.

We can apply the payment, but we need a quick confirmation to make sure VAT is posted correctly in your accounting. The bulk amount you sent maps to these outstanding items on our side (current balances):
• Invoice 1145 — EUR 132,000.00 (net) + EUR 26,400.00 VAT = EUR 158,400.00
• Invoice 1146 — EUR 80,000.00 (net) + EUR 7,200.00 VAT = EUR 87,200.00
• Invoice 1147 (credit memo) — EUR (0)

Proposed default allocation: apply EUR 158,400 to Invoice 1145 and EUR 87,200 to Invoice 1146, which equals the EUR 245,600 you wired. However, VAT on Invoice 1146 currently reflects a reduced VAT amount on our ledger; if you intended to allocate VAT differently (for example, apply only the VAT portion to invoice 1145), we need explicit confirmation.

Can you confirm whether Greenline wants the VAT split: (A) apply VAT to both invoices proportionally, or (B) apply all VAT to Invoice 1145 and treat Invoice 1146 as net-only with a separate VAT credit? If you prefer (B), we will hold the isolated VAT as a credit and mark it for assignment once you confirm.

Also please attach a bank trace PDF that shows GLN-SWEEP-0503 and the beneficiary details so Finance Ops can clear the sweep. I have attached a quick proposed allocation worksheet for your convenience (proposed_allocation.xlsx).

If you confirm by EOD CET we will post the allocations today and send a posting confirmation + PDF evidence for your records.

Thanks,
